name: Remaz
desc:
**Remaz** was one of the side-characters in the book Lament of Cirryn. He is a Lifeweave scholar of [The Hive](faction:the_hive), who was sent out on a mission along with 2 other scholars to revive [Cirryn](entity:cirryn) by a hivelord [Ximac Diri](entity:ximac_diri).

**Remaz** was a very snooty man, constantly making fun of Ehkusa and not realizing how much he hurts her feelings. Although, after he crossed the line and making fun of Ehkusa's dead friend, [Ryrda](entity:ryrda), he apologized to her and stopped. He was also very caring, rather sacrificing himself, than letting his friends die.
